metadata.description: ALRT-03: Abnormal Usage Pattern alert rule with dynamic thresholds and bidirectional detection. Monitors agent session volumes and triggers on both spikes and drops to detect anomalous behavior patterns.
Base name for the alert rule (zone suffix will be appended)
Resource ID of the Application Insights instance to monitor
Resource ID of the Zone 1 (Personal Productivity) Action Group
Resource ID of the Zone 2 (Team Collaboration) Action Group
Resource ID of the Zone 3 (Enterprise Managed) Action Group
Whether the alert rule is enabled
Location for the alert rule resources

properties.displayName: ALRT-03: Abnormal Usage Pattern - Zone 1 (Personal Productivity)
properties.description: Alert when agent session volume deviates significantly from learned baseline (both spikes and drops). Zone 1 uses Low sensitivity for personal productivity agents with higher tolerance for usage variability.

allOf.query:
let ZoneFilter = 'Zone 1 - Personal Productivity';
customEvents
| where timestamp > ago(15m)
| where name in ('BotMessageReceived', 'BotMessageSend')
| where tostring(customDimensions['DesignMode']) == 'False'
| where tostring(customDimensions['Zone']) == ZoneFilter or ZoneFilter == 'all'
| extend AgentId = tostring(customDimensions['recipientId'])
| summarize SessionCount = dcount(session_Id) by AgentId
| summarize TotalSessions = sum(SessionCount)
